elements_not_encoded.text: If systolic BP > 90, give furosemide 40mg slow IV. If no response after 30 minutes, give another 80mg IV. If good response, give 40mg IV after 2-4 hours.
If systolic BP > 90, give sublingual isosorbide dinitrate 5mg even if there is no chest pain. Repeat every 10 minutes if SBP remains >90.
If BP ≥ 180/130, give single dose enalapril 10mg orally.
